body.x: CORAL SPRINGS, FL, December 20, 2012 – (Virtual Press Office) -- Power Bright Technologies, the leader in power inverters, will introduce their game-changing lines of power inverters at CES 2013 in their Booth #30263, South Hall 4.

Power Bright's revolutionary products include the Power Bright XC180 – 180 Watt Cup Power Inverter, which was recently named an International CES Innovations 2013 Design and Engineering Awards Honoree. The XC180 Cup Power Inverter is one of two patent pending Power Bright Cup Inverters deemed the World's Smallest Cup Inverter™.1,2 The XC180 is an ultra compact power inverter with robust appeal.

Power Bright's XC180 – 180 Watt Cup Power Inverter will be displayed in The Venetian at the 2013 International CES, which runs January 8-11, 2013 in Las Vegas, Nevada. Honorees' products will also be displayed at CES Unveiled: The Official Press Event of the International CES from 4-7 p.m. on Sunday, January 6 in the South Seas Ballroom C at Mandalay Bay.
All of the new products in Power Bright's signature line of power inverters and their new line of Energizer branded Power Inverters will officially debut at CES 2013.3

In the U.S., during the recent aftermath of Superstorm Sandy, many consumers turned to Power Bright's line of Power Inverters to charge their laptops, cellphones and other digital devices. In addition, many consumers used their larger watt models to run their home appliances such as refrigerators and microwaves until their regular power sources were restored.

Innovations 2013 Design and Engineering honoree products are featured on http://cesweb.org/Awards/CES-Innovations-Awards.aspx, which lists product categories, as well as each product name, manufacturer information, designer, description, photo and URL.
Power Bright Technology's VPO Press Kit is available at Power Bright CES Press Kit.

Power Bright Technologies is a privately held company who designs and manufactures the most technologically advanced power products on the market today and is the leader in power inverters. By pioneering new technologies and continuously refining their existing products, Power Bright sets the standards in today's power conversion industry.

Committed to continuously offering the most innovative, efficient, and environmentally responsible equipment, Power Bright invests significant resources in ongoing research and development. Headquartered in Florida (USA), the company has warehouses in North Carolina and Quebec, Canada as well as operates their own state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Suzhou, China.
For more information, please visit www.powerbright.com. Product information and images are available upon request.
